title: Level-map prior head
summary: Adds the training-only head that learns each frame's projected level map beside the level loss.
does: The prior block (#228): a head on the backbone learns a frame's projected level map, 28 classes at every pixel (the 27 levels and the background), its loss weighted by weight beside the level loss. Only crops whose frame has a map teach it. The head is not in best.pt (prior_head.pt lies beside it), so the network that names levels is unchanged (tools/train.py).

outputs.name: model
outputs.what: The same network with the prior head for training.

params.name: weight
params.what: the prior loss's weight beside the level loss, above 0 (grid/sweeps/real.json uses 0.5); 100 is the sandbox's cap

nondeterminism: The new head starts from a random draw made under its trainer's seed, so the network repeats only with that seed.

generic.why: The level map is a 2-D frame's projected map (tools/train.py); a volume would need a 3-D map and a 3-D head.

today.note: the request's block lines prior and prior_weight
